2607.26742.title: Zero-Shot Face-to-Speech Synthesis via Latent Space Adaptation of a Style-Diffusion TTS Model
2607.26742.paper_summary: Zero-shot text-to-speech (TTS) clones a voice from a short audio prompt, but this reliance on reference audio is a barrier when only visual information is available, e.g. for historical figures or video-game characters. In this work, we propose a Face-to-Speech (F2S) framework that predicts a plausible voice from a static facial image. A lightweight Face Adapter, together with soft-tuning of the face encoder's upper blocks, aligns face-recognition features with the style space of a frozen StyleTTS 2 model, kept frozen during training. We evaluate on held-out identities from LRS3, a large-scale audiovisual corpus of English TED-talk videos. The synthesized speech is highly natural (UTMOS 3.7-4.0, matching or exceeding the 3.61 of ground truth), face-to-voice retrieval is consistently above chance, and the generated voice is consistent with the target speaker. Without any retraining, an English-trained adapter also produces fluent Spanish speech, indicating that the face-to-style mapping is largely language-agnostic.
2607.26742.paper_summary_zh: 零-shot 文字轉語音 (TTS) 從短音訊提示中複製聲音，但這種對參考音訊的依賴在僅有視覺信息可用時成為障礙，例如對於歷史人物或視頻遊戲角色。在這項工作中，我們提出了一個面部轉語音 (F2S) 框架，該框架從靜態面部圖像中預測出合理的聲音。一個輕量級的面部適配器，連同對面部編碼器上層區塊的軟調整，將面部識別特徵與凍結的 StyleTTS 2 模型的風格空間對齊，該模型在訓練期間保持凍結。我們在 LRS3 上進行評估，這是一個大型的英語 TED 演講視頻的視聽語料庫，包含保留的身份。合成的語音非常自然 (UTMOS 3.7-4.0，與真實值 3.61 相匹配或超過)，面對語音檢索的準確率始終高於隨機機率，生成的聲音與目標說話者一致。在沒有任何重新訓練的情況下，英語訓練的適配器也能生成流利的西班牙語語音，這表明面部到風格的映射在很大程度上是語言無關的。
2607.26742.author: Carlos Muñoz-Romero et.al.
